features.notes: Verifies E1–E7 (E–E), 73 total keys, 43 white/30 black, hammer action, measured aspect ratio 3.0951.
Verifies six ordered sections (Performance, Organ, Piano, Program, Synth, Effects) with measured allocations and 54/46 vertical split.
Verifies section-specific controls with stable IDs and accessible names across all six sections.
Verifies all 73 keys respond to pointer, keyboard, and MIDI with correct note-on/off lifecycle.
Verifies all panel controls move/press decoratively without affecting audio.
Verifies all controls have stable IDs and accessible names.
Verifies Piano voice with velocity, sustain, polyphony, voice stealing, release envelope.
Verifies Piano responds to pointer, keyboard, MIDI with independent tracking and graceful fallback.
Verifies sustain pedal, 8-voice polyphony, voice stealing, exponential release.
Verifies audio status display, all-notes-off on blur/unmount/disconnect.
Verifies continuous red chassis, no clipped keys at mobile viewport.
